Highly recommended for anyone looking for reliable and high-quality tailoring, especially when you need something done quickly.

featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
**“We have not charged you anything extra for the exchange.
The jeans you originally purchased had an MRP of ₹800, and after discount it cost you ₹700.
The jeans you have taken now in exchange have an MRP of ₹999, and after discount it comes to ₹900.
That is why the bill shows ₹200 extra.

Just like in medical stores or any other shops, product prices vary; the same happens in garment stores as well—every item has a different price.

Also, earlier you took a size 36 jeans and now you have taken size 38, so a price difference is natural.
Size 38 jeans usually cost more, but we always try to offer the lowest possible price.

It is difficult to get a size 38 jeans of this quality for ₹999, sir.
Still, if you felt any inconvenience, we sincerely apologize.”**
